d:
Rahul Gandhi 1 November Rally:rajdhani dilli men 1 navanbar ko kangres ki raili hone vali hai, jismen I.N.D.I.A. blok ke bare neta shamil honge. jharkhand se kaee basen dilli ravana ki gaee hain. raili ko kamyab banane ke lie parti ne puri takat jhonk rakhi hai. vahin, dilli men kangres ki raili ko lekar jharkhand men juban jang chhir gaee hai.
